summary: Teaching subtractive synth: one Dye Essence patch driven by 12 controls. A wave that morphs from sine through triangle and saw to pulse, a sub oscillator one octave down, a 24 dB/oct low-pass with resonance, drive and a filter envelope, an ADSR, unison and an output gain. Every control says what it does and what you will hear. Use it for basses, leads, pads and plucks, or to learn how subtractive synthesis works.

parameters.name: Cutoff
parameters.description: Sets the corner frequency of the 24 dB/octave low-pass filter above which upper harmonics are attenuated.
parameters.how: Sets the corner frequency of the 24 dB/octave low-pass filter above which upper harmonics are attenuated.
parameters.sound: Lowering it makes the sound dark, muted, and warm; raising it lets bright, buzzy harmonics through.

parameters.name: Resonance
parameters.description: Feeds a narrow band of frequencies at the cutoff point back into the filter input to create a resonant peak.
parameters.how: Feeds a narrow band of frequencies at the cutoff point back into the filter input to create a resonant peak.
parameters.sound: Adds a sharp, vocal, or whistling edge to filter sweeps and emphasizes the cutoff frequency.

parameters.name: Wave Shape
parameters.description: Continuously crossfades the primary oscillator through Sine (0%), Triangle (33%), Sawtooth (66%), and Pulse (100%).
parameters.how: Continuously crossfades the primary oscillator through Sine (0%), Triangle (33%), Sawtooth (66%), and Pulse (100%).
parameters.sound: Transitions the raw tone from pure and flute-like to bright and brassy, then hollow and nasal.

parameters.name: Sub Osc
parameters.description: Blends in a phase-locked square wave oscillator pitched one octave below the played note.
parameters.how: Blends in a phase-locked square wave oscillator pitched one octave below the played note.
parameters.sound: Adds deep low-end weight and foundation for basslines and massive leads.

parameters.name: Env to Filter
parameters.description: Scales how strongly the main ADSR envelope sweeps the filter cutoff frequency on each note.
parameters.how: Scales how strongly the main ADSR envelope sweeps the filter cutoff frequency on each note.
parameters.sound: Positive values create punchy, brassy, or plucked filter transients that mellow out as the note decays.

parameters.name: Drive
parameters.description: Applies soft hyperbolic tangent (`tanh`) saturation before the filter and subtle per-voice pitch drift.
parameters.how: Applies soft hyperbolic tangent (`tanh`) saturation before the filter and subtle per-voice pitch drift.
parameters.sound: Compresses peaks, adds warm harmonic grit, and mimics vintage analog hardware instability.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the note's amplitude (and routed envelope modulation) to ramp from silence to full peak after a note-on trigger.
parameters.sound: Low values create immediate, percussive plucks; high values produce slow, swelling pads.

parameters.name: Decay
parameters.description: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.how: Controls how long it takes for the signal to drop from peak level down to the sustain level while a key remains held.
parameters.sound: Short decay makes notes snappy and tight; longer decay gives a gradual piano- or bell-like fade.

parameters.name: Sustain
parameters.description: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.how: Defines the steady-state volume level maintained for as long as a note is held after the Attack and Decay stages complete.
parameters.sound: At 0% the synth behaves like a plucked or struck instrument; at 100% it holds full organ-like volume.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.how: Sets the time required for the sound to fade from its current level to complete silence after the note is released.
parameters.sound: Short release stops notes abruptly; long release leaves an ambient tail that blends chords together.

parameters.name: Unison / Spread
parameters.description: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.how: 0% plays one voice per note; above 0% each note plays 5 detuned, stereo-spread voices (3 in Additive, Granular and Spectral), with detune (up to ±50 cents) and width growing with the value.
parameters.sound: Thickens thin waveforms into wide, chorus-like stereo leads and pads.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.how: Sets the level after synthesis. There is no limiter (NeoBuzz mixes in floating point); a clip light shows when the output passes 0 dBFS.
parameters.sound: Controls overall loudness; keep the clip light dark when the next machine expects levels at or below 0 dBFS.
